description: A mixer in which every output carries a blend of the patched inputs, each weighted by how far its jack is from that output

params.text: Scales every output from silence to twice the level, applied after the mix and clamped to plus or minus 10V
Steps through three ways an input reaches the outputs: falling away with distance, at full level on every output, or filtered, an output below an input low-passing it and one above it high-passing it

inputs.text: A signal fed into the mix, reaching each output at a level set by its distance from this jack; the channels of a polyphonic cable here are summed

outputs.text: The blend of the patched inputs weighted by their distance from this jack, scaled by the gain knob

notes: in filter mode an output one jack from the input passes a 16kHz lowpass or a 60Hz highpass, and one seven jacks away passes a 100Hz lowpass or an 8kHz highpass
the filter cutoffs come from a fixed table of frequencies chosen by ear, not from ratios worked out from the distance
patching an output back into an input makes a sub-mix, which is how more than eight channels are mixed in one module
menu: Filters — the slope used in filter mode: 6dB per octave, or 12dB per octave, which is the default
